summary: A TypeScript package for npm, built to ESM with type declarations and checked as the tarball users will install.
description: Start a TypeScript package meant for npm. The starter has one small public function with an options object, a documented error type with stable codes, and a single entry point whose exports are pinned by a test. tsdown builds ESM and bundled type declarations, publint and Are the Types Wrong check the package settings, and a consumer check installs the packed tarball into a clean project, then typechecks and runs it. The package stays private until you decide to publish, which you do yourself.
seoDescription: A TypeScript npm package starter with tsdown, publint, Are the Types Wrong, Vitest and a packed-tarball install test.

projectExamples.title: Shared utilities for several apps
projectExamples.description: An illustrative package of helpers your team's apps install from npm or a private registry instead of copying code between repositories. Publishing and registry access stay your step.

projectExamples.title: Typed client for a web service
projectExamples.description: An illustrative SDK that wraps a service's HTTP calls in typed functions with one error type. Network calls, retries and authentication are yours to add.

plain.whatItIs: A starter for a reusable TypeScript code package that other JavaScript and TypeScript projects install from npm, the public package registry.
goodAt: Sharing tested code between several projects
Catching packaging mistakes before anyone installs the package
Giving users accurate type hints in their editor
notGoodAt: Apps people open or visit; pick a web, CLI or API stack.
Publishing for you; you run the release yourself.
